desc: Analyze small cases (N=1..6) via reduced game state (unactivated set + total pass pool), confirming f(P) forms and initial outcomes.
Prove for N>=4 by induction that mover wins at pool P iff (E+P) is odd, giving Fennec wins iff count of odd A_i is odd; establish bases N=1,2,3.
Implement the O(N) Python solution: N==1 -> Fennec; N==2 -> Snuke; N==3 -> Fennec iff some A_i odd else Snuke; N>=4 -> Fennec iff number of odd A_i is odd.
Test against samples 1,2,3 (Fennec, Snuke, Snuke) and against a brute-force minimax on small N<=4, A_i<=3.
Confirm code handles N up to 2×10^5 and A_i up to 10^9 with O(N) time and stdin/stdout.
